load_model_from_pretrained: load a causal language model from HuggingFace using AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained
load_tokenizer_from_pretrained: load a tokenizer from HuggingFace using AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained
load_calibration_dataset: load and preprocess a HuggingFace dataset for model calibration with chat templates
run_oneshot_calibration: run the llmcompressor oneshot calibration pass with sequential prefetch enabled
benchmark_sequential_prefetch: benchmark the sequential prefetch pipeline timing the oneshot calibration call
